title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
description: Microsoft's October Windows Server security updates have been confirmed to cause issues with Outlook Web Access (OWA) sign-in and mail delivery on some Exchange Server systems. This disruption affects the normal operation of Exchange Server mail flow and user access via OWA.
aiSummary: Microsoft acknowledged that the Windows Server security updates released in October are causing problems specifically with OWA sign-in and mail flow on certain Exchange Server deployments. The updates interfere with Exchange Server functionality, leading to authentication failures and mail delivery disruptions. No detailed technical root cause or exploit information is provided in the available data.
aiImpact: Affected Exchange Server systems experience failures in OWA sign-in and interruptions in mail delivery, potentially impacting user access to email and the flow of mail within affected environments. This can disrupt business communications relying on Exchange Server.
